phase: Predeclared analytical development probe motivated by C04, not a held-out comparison or method selection result
inputs: Known-ID grid correspondences and analytical image positions. No neural detector and no M3 or M2 image bank.
source_projection: [10*u/(1+k*u), 10*v/(1+k*u)] after the named analytic coordinate deformation
arms: global homography LS, restricted to original observed-cell support
T_LS composed with H_LS, inverse H_LS^-1 composed with T_LS^-1
global homography RANSAC, restricted to original observed-cell support
T_RANSAC composed with H_RANSAC, inverse H_RANSAC^-1 composed with T_RANSAC^-1

homography.horizon_guard: denominator same nonzero sign over every observed source vertex

cases.name: flat-coherent-half-error
cases.anchor_fault: x shift 13 pixels for canonical u>=25mm

guard_fault_controls: Four source correspondences with swapped bottom endpoints induce a fitted homography whose horizon crosses the source cell, and must be rejected
Collinear input anchors must return explicit rejection rather than fabricate a field
prohibited: No product attribution to Powerful Medical
No oracle selection of a branch by query error
No new settings selected after reading these scores
No RGB-delivery or end-to-end detector claim
expected_tradeoff: Composition should remove projective interpolation bias when H is appropriate. It can still overfit anchor noise, preserve wrong IDs, fail with a bad global fit or be biased near nonlinear creases. Negative controls remain in the output.
